records.publisher: North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox
records.shortExcerpt: Rosemary does best in light, slightly acidic, dry to medium, well-drained soils.
records.reviewerSummary: Dry-to-medium is a source range limitation and does not create a second medium reviewed claim. Active corroboration for the relatively dry and well-drained preference. Persistently wet soil and overwatering are risks. Publication and update dates are not displayed.
records.normalizedClaim: Salvia rosmarinus prefers relatively dry, well-drained growing conditions and has low tolerance for persistently wet soil.
